scope: Click magnification, evidence-reviewed object followup, OCR geometry merge and diagnostic-only source-pixel video protection

input_boundary.live_checks: previously saved authorized book frames and generated clips; developer-authored questions

verification.saved_clip_cli: local-only command completed; source book file sizes and modification times unchanged; no model call
verification.restarted_workbench: HTTP homepage and status available on 8765, seven object-assistant routes present, generation idle
verification.actual_synthetic_video: protected source pixels, preserved raw hash/duration and motion in unprotected regions verified using real FFmpeg output

after_click_crop_before_followup_crop.followup: rejected by current-action evidence review; not counted as successful

live_click_checks.method: isolated ASGI HTTP routes with actual configured services; no browser, real microphone or speaker listening
live_click_checks.limitations: small development sample, different code revisions, not overall recognition accuracy, P50/P95, independent-book generalization or official latency compliance

observed_limitations: source region geometry may be incomplete

remaining_work: Validate registration/tracking or other source-preserving generation controls before enabling video repair
Resolve all original quality failures and uncertainties before releasing full-book output
Browser operation, real microphone, speaker listening and longer continuous interaction
Formal evaluation interface, final official latency threshold and designated human safety review
